comment: Linking each case or contact to a verified Client Registry or foundational identity is unsafe as a universal expectation. Surveillance must accommodate unknown persons, rapidly evolving outbreaks, migrants, undocumented people and sensitive conditions. Mandatory verification can delay notification, deter care and create unnecessary cross-sector linkage.

public.text: Linking each case or contact to a verified Client Registry or foundational identity is unsafe as a universal expectation. Surveillance must accommodate unknown persons, rapidly evolving outbreaks, migrants, undocumented people and sensitive conditions. Mandatory verification can delay notification, deter care and create unnecessary cross-sector linkage.
public.suggestedRevision: Require identity-optional case creation, temporary and pseudonymous identifiers, later reconciliation where necessary, strict separation of civil and health identifiers, and no denial or delay of care/reporting. Make Client Registry linkage a governed, risk-assessed option rather than a prerequisite.
